models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Left Trailer Tail Lamps (M60) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Left Trailer Tail Lamps (M60)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Left Trailer Tail Lamps (M60)
technicalNotes: This Fault Code is stored when the Trailer Control Module Lamp Diagnosis finds a faulty Lamp. In case of LED Lamps the Lamp Diagnosis may not be accurate and the Fault Code would be stored without a Lamp being actually faulty.
